description: Modal dialog that renders the current email document as read-only source, toggling between generated MJML and the document's JSON representation for copying.

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Raised when the dialog is closed.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: The layout the dialog renders in. Auto measures the viewport, so the dialog becomes the core sheet on a phone (F2); the editor passes the layout it already resolved, which keeps the dialog in step with the editor and makes the sheet presentation testable without a DOM.
